name: Yemi
message:
Mine,

Today, as you turn 50, my heart is filled with gratitude to God for the priceless gift that you are to me, our family, the church of God and the younger generation you have sold yourself out for.

Celebrating you is not just about marking a birthday; it is about honouring a life of love, sacrifice, strength, and unwavering devotion.

For 22 beautiful years, you have been my true helpmate, my partner in every season, a foundation upon which our home stands strong, my financial adviser, and a true helpmate in ministry. You didn’t just build a house, you built a haven of peace, a place of laughter, and a sanctuary of love. Your hands have nurtured, your heart has held us together, and your wisdom has guided our path.

At 50, you shine even brighter, full of grace, dignity, and beauty that goes far beyond the outward. You are a woman of strength and virtue, whose worth is far above rubies. In you, I have found not just a wife, but a friend, and a divine blessing I will forever cherish.

Thank you for standing by me, believing in me, and loving me through it all. If I had to live this life over again, I would choose you every single time without hesitation.

Happy 50th Birthday, Mine (Teminikan). May this new chapter bring you even greater joy, peace, and fulfilment. The best is not behind you; it is still ahead, and I am grateful that I get to walk every step of it with you.

All my love,

name: Oluwatomisin Olaleye
message:
Happy 50th Birthday, Mum!

I have always admired your incredible ability to be both the firm disciplinarian we need and the gentle confidante we cherish, all in the same breath. You are always there to cheer us on and support our dreams, while never failing to provide the sound advice that keeps us grounded.

Your journey to 50 is such a beautiful testament to God’s goodness. While your smile is contagious, it is your resilience and strength that truly define you and act as an anchor for our entire family.

As you hit this incredible milestone, I pray that your years ahead are filled with even more miracles and blessings, so that you can continue to be a light to me, my siblings, and everyone around you.

Cheers to 50 years of being the absolute best!

With Love,

name: Oluwateniola Olaleye
message:
Happy birthday, Mummy! Thank you for being the true epitome of resilience and joy.

I am so grateful for the godly values you’ve instilled in me and for the way you’ve built me up in every facet of my life. I can’t even begin to count the times you’ve helped me, strengthened me, and cheered me on. Thank you for being my manager, my guide, and truly the best mother anyone could ever wish for.

Happy Golden Jubilee! I love you!

name: Oluwatisefunmi Olaleye
message:
To my dear mother, on your 50th birthday, thank you for everything you are. If I had to choose a mother again, I would choose you without thinking twice.

What makes you truly remarkable is not only what you have accomplished for yourself, but what you have done for others. I often tell you that you take on "unnecessary" stress for people, but you always remind me that a successful life is measured by what we do for others. Time and again, you have shown up when it was inconvenient, given freely, and loved deeply.

You are a woman of high standards, both for yourself and for those you love. You have achieved so much through sheer determination and an unshakeable belief that excellence is worth the pursuit. I admire you greatly for your strength; you are kind, but you are not soft. You have that rare gift of making me feel both completely loved and constantly challenged to be better. You aren't afraid to stand up for what is right, and you lead us all by example.

This milestone is a celebration of a life generously lived. You deserve every beautiful thing this new season holds, and I wish you many more years of joy and impact.

Happy Birthday, Mom.

With Love Always,

name: Oluwabukunmi Fadeyi
message:
I Am Because You Are: A Tribute to My North Star.

Whenever I speak about you, no matter the occasion, I always begin with the same truth: "I am because you are."

I kept postponing writing this tribute, even as I chased everyone else for theirs, because how do I even begin to quantify the impact you’ve had on my life? I was just a child of ten, newly arrived in your home while you were pregnant with Tomisin. You opened your heart and home to me and changed my world.

Growing up, Baba always compared me to you; two quiet, studious girls with our noses always buried in books. But it wasn’t until I moved in with you that I truly knew you. You opened my eyes to the woman I could become, and I have moved through life with that truth at the centre of my being. In the truest sense of the word, you are my soulmate. I feel so incredibly lucky to be so connected to you.

We don’t always agree on everything, but that is the beauty of us; at our core, we are anchored by the same values. You carried me through secondary school and university, ensuring I had the best start in life. You instilled in me the value of hard work and the power of being well-spoken and writing well, the very wings that carry me today. When people compliment how I speak or write, I tell them I owe it to you. I am firmly planted today because I stand on the ground you levelled through your labour of love.

You paved the way for me in ways I can never fully repay. When my mother passed, you were the only person I thought to call. You travelled to Owo that same day, stepping in to handle everything because we were too young to face it alone. I know I wasn’t always the easiest daughter to raise, but you never gave up on me, and for that, I am eternally grateful.

You once told me something as a teenager that became my North Star: "Nkan ti o ni enu o le gbon ju e lo" (What doesn't have a mouth cannot be wiser than you). That phrase has pulled me out of some seemingly impossible situations. It reminds me that I can find a way out of any tight corner.

I could fill twenty pages and still not be done. On this Golden Jubilee, my heart is simply bursting. What an extraordinary and impactful life you have lived. You inspire me in more ways than I can put into words. Looking back at our humble beginnings, it is incredible to see how you refused to let circumstances define or limit you. I hope you take a moment to look at the beautiful life you’ve built and feel immense pride in everything you have achieved.

I pray that your light never dims. When you call for help, ten thousand shall arise to answer. You will never know a "better" yesterday, for your path will only shine brighter and brighter. All the lives you have touched in your 50 years of existence will always speak for you.

Egbon mi, Iye mi, the lover of my soul, Happy 50th Birthday! Arise and shine, for your light has come and the glory of the Lord rises upon you. I haven't forgotten my promises, I am still going to buy you that car and take you on those trips around the world, you’ll see!

Never forget; I am because you are. I love you to the moon and back, and until a day after forever.

With my heart in a pretty pink bow,

name: Tedimola Abisola
message:
Happy 50th birthday, Mummy. What a beautiful day to celebrate you.

Thank you so much for your kindness, your warmth, and the effortless love you show me. You didn’t just welcome me into your home; you welcomed me into your heart and made me family, and for that I will always be grateful.

You have been a source of strength, wisdom, and comfort, and I am truly blessed to have you in my life. Thank you for the motherly check-ins; distance has never been a barrier to the love and care you give so freely.

Today, I celebrate you, not just for the amazing woman you are, but also for the incredible mother you have been to me. May this new chapter bring you even more joy, good health, peace, and all the happiness your heart can hold.

Happy 50th birthday, Mummy. Love you forever!

name: Victoria and Temilade Adebisi
message:
Happy birthday, Mummy. Today we celebrate you for your unconditional love, kindness and for being very intentional about us. We love you so much and pray that God bless you always.

With Love,

name: The iLead Lagos Team
message:
Celebrating Greatness @50

Mrs Olaitan Olaleye (iLead Lagos State Team Lead)

Today, we pause to honour a woman whose leadership has been a quiet, steady flame — guiding us with wisdom, purpose, and an unmistakable grace. Mrs Olaitan Olaleye, you have given selflessly of your time, vision, and heart to the iLead Lagos family, building a team that reflects your values — excellence, service, and calm strength.

Your vision continues to inspire us every day. As you mark this golden milestone, we celebrate not just the years but the extraordinary person you are.

Happy 50th Birthday, Ma!

May this new chapter be filled with joy, health, and every good thing.

— With love and gratitude,

name: RCCG Strongtower Ministers
message:
Today, we celebrate not just a birthday but a life of impact, grace, and unwavering service to God and His people.

Dear Mama, at 50, your life stands as a testament to what it means to walk faithfully with God. You have been more than a pastor’s wife, you have been a mother, a partner, a mentor, a counsellor, and a pillar of strength to both the ministry and every one of us as ministers.

As Proverbs 31:26 says, 'She opens her mouth with wisdom, and the teaching of kindness is on her tongue.' You've shaped countless lives with your kindness, compassion, and generosity. Your personal commitment to the well-being of everyone around you is an inspiration to us all. Your quiet sacrifices, your words of wisdom, your prayers, and your consistent support to everyone are overwhelming. You have carried burdens with grace, led with humility, and loved with sincerity.

Your passion for the children, particularly the teenagers, young adults, and youth, knows no bounds.

On behalf of all the ministers, we celebrate you for your dedication to the work of God, your steadfast commitment to the vision of this ministry, and your nurturing heart that continues to raise and strengthen us.

As you mark this golden milestone, we pray that God renews your strength, enlarges your coast, increases your joy, and rewards you abundantly for every seed you have sown in His vineyard in Jesus Christ's mighty name.

May this new chapter bring you greater peace, deeper fulfilment, and even more remarkable testimonies.

Happy 50th Birthday, dear Mummy Olaleye.

We love, honour, and celebrate you dearly.

name: RCCG Strongtower Children’s Church
message:
Happy 50th birthday, Mummy!

We love you so, so much! Thank you for loving us and carrying us when we cry. You always make us feel safe and happy. Thank you for the biscuits and sweets you give us, we will never forget.

You teach us about Jesus in a way we understand, and it makes us love Him more. A little girl once wrote a note to you saying that you are kind. Yes! You are kind, gentle, and a lot of fun. We like it when you smile, laugh, and dance with us. We always look forward to your heartfelt prayers.

We pray God will bless you, make you strong, and give you many more happy years. We love you big, big, Mummy!!!

name: RCCG Strongtower Teens Church
message:
From all of us in Teens Church, thank you for being so amazing through the years.

We’ve heard from those ahead of us how you’ve always been awesome, and now we get to experience it ourselves.

With all our drama, our moods, our tantrums, and even our little delinquency, you still show up for us every single time. You never get tired of loving us, guiding us, and praying for us. Your love and encouragement mean everything to us. You’ve shown us real love and real faith, and we’re so grateful, Ma.

Happy 50th birthday, Ma!!!

name: Dr Abu Noruwa, Chairman, RCCG Strongtower Elders.
message:
Happy Birthday, Pastor Mrs Olaleye!

On this special day, on behalf of the Elders of RCCG Strongtower, I celebrate the grace of God upon your life and your unwavering dedication to His work. Your teachings, prayers, and guidance have been a blessing and an inspiration to many.

May the Lord continue to strengthen you, enlarge your ministry, and fill your life with divine wisdom, good health, and abundant joy. May your new year be marked with greater anointing, peace, and fulfilment in all that you do.

Wishing you many more fruitful and impactful years in the vineyard of the Lord.

Happy Birthday, Ma!

name: Pastor and Pastor (Mrs) Gbenga and Idowu Oyebode
message:
Happy Golden Jubilee Celebration to the Amiable Woman of God and wife of our beloved APICP Admin Lagos Province 44, Pastor (Mrs) Olaitan Olaleye

Your kindness, love, and dedication inspire us all. Beside a Great Man is a greater Woman and you are that woman. Your strength, wisdom, and compassion are a blessing to your family and ministry.

May God bless you abundantly, grant you joy, and continue to make your life a testament to His love.

Happy birthday, ma.

name: Pastors Olubusola and Felix Aremo
message:
APICP CSR, Lagos Province 44

Mummy Olaleye, our children’s counsellor, friend and Pastor’s wife. Your presence in our lives has been a Godsend.  Over the years, you’ve become more than a friend; you’ve become a sister to us.

On your golden jubilee, we say, Igba Odun, Odun kan ni ninu Alaafia ati Oju rere Jesu Olugbala.

Love Always,

name: Mummy Olugboroko
message:
For Olakitan at 50

To my niece turn sister, Olakiitan

A rare blend of grace and strength. You are pleasant in spirit, supportive without limits, astonishing in the quiet way you show up, and vibrant in every room you enter.

Hardworking and a true goal getter, you chase purpose, not praise. Above all, you are God-fearing — the anchor that keeps you steady and kind. Always there to help whenever called upon, yet a lady of few words, filled with wisdom that speaks louder than noise.

At 50, you carry the beauty of a life well-lived and the fire of one still unfolding. Your laugh disarms tension, your counsel steadies hearts, and your loyalty never wavers. You lead by example, love without condition, and give without counting cost.

May this new decade bring you deeper joy, sweeter rest, and doors only God can open. May your health flourish, your dreams expand, and your impact multiply. Thank you for being the sister who is also a friend, a prayer partner, and a safe place.

I celebrate you today, Olakiitan. Fifty looks luminous on you. Happy 50th Birthday!

name: A/P Rachael Oladunni Fatuyi
message:
Kiitan is a very honest, warm and caring person. Wishing you a very happy 50th birthday. You will celebrate more years in good health and prosperity in Jesus Name. More anointing! Congratulations on this milestone celebration! Welcome to the 5th floor!

Much love,

name: Elder Ibikunle Fadeyi
message:
Omaluka (Ogho dialect)

Translation: Good child.

Kiitan exudes the nobility & high morality of her source & paternity - The Ojumu chieftaincy of Ogho Kingdom. She is as TRUTHFUL as salt. Happy Golden Jubilee, Olakiitan! Aseyi Samodun. -

name: Pastor & Pastor ( Mrs) Emmanuel Olugbenga Fadeyi
message:
TRIBUTE TO A WONDERFUL SISTER AT 50.

Today, we celebrate not just a birthday, but a beautiful life well lived. Happy 50th birthday to an extraordinary daughter and a sister, a woman of strength, grace, and unwavering love.

You have been more than a sister to us; you have been a confidant and a constant source of inspiration. Through every season, your courage has shone brightly, your kindness has touched lives, and your wisdom has brought clarity and peace to those around you.

Fifty years of impact, laughter, resilience, and love is no small milestone. Your life is a testament to God’s faithfulness, and your journey continues to inspire everyone privileged to know you.

Thank you for being a pride to the family and for your sacrifices, your prayers, and your endless support. The world is better because you are in it, and we are so blessed to call you our sister.

As you step into this golden season, may your days be filled with joy, your heart with peace, and your life with even greater fulfilment. The best is truly yet to come.

We love and celebrate you today and always. Happy golden anniversary!

name: Mike and Stella Fadeyi
message: Happy 50th Birthday, Mummy! Today, we celebrate you and give thanks to God for the wonderful gift of your life. We pray that this new chapter is filled with joy, peace, and God’s abundant blessings.

name: Blessing Oluwaseun Fadeyi
message:
Today, I celebrate a truly special woman, my aunt, whose presence in my life has been nothing short of a huge blessing.

You are a woman of strength, kindness, and grace. The love you give is genuine, the care you show is effortless, and the impact you make in the lives of others is lasting. You have a way of making people feel comfortable, valued, and deeply appreciated just by being yourself.

Your wisdom, encouragement, and support have shaped me in more ways than I can fully express. In moments when I needed guidance, you were there. In times of joy, you celebrated with me. Your role in my life goes far beyond being an auntie; you are a mother, my coach, a confidant, and a constant source of inspiration.

I admire your resilience, your heart, and the way you carry yourself with dignity. You are a shining example of what it means to live with purpose and love.

Thank you for being you. Thank you for the sacrifices, the selflessness and the countless little things you do that mean so much. You are deeply loved, truly appreciated, and forever celebrated.

I love you so much.

name: Joy Fadeyi
message: Sweet mum, thanks for all that you do for the family. You’re an amazing and sweet soul. You no dey disappoint at all. God bless and keep you in Jesus name. I love you to the moon and back.

name: Rotimi Fadeyi
message: Happy 50th Birthday, 'Laitan. The Golden Jubilee is another Milestone and Celebration in your life.  God will continue to make your life Fruitful and Glorious. Cheers!! Remain Blessed

name: Sule-Oderinde Helen Molayonu (Mrs)
message:
Happy 50th Birthday to my beloved sister, Pastor Laitan Olaleye. Today, I celebrate fifty beautiful years of God’s faithfulness, grace, and your incredible impact on everyone privileged to know you. I truly cannot thank God enough for the priceless gift of a sister like you. You have been my confidant, my encourager, and my safe place through many seasons of life. Through laughter and tears, challenges and victories, you have remained strong, holding firmly to your faith in God and showing love to all around you.

I deeply admire how gracefully you carry your many roles, as a devoted wife, a caring mother, a dependable aunt, a hardworking career woman, and a passionate pastor committed to God’s work. Your compassion, patience, and strength have touched countless lives, and I am grateful to be one of those blessed by you.

As you step into this golden chapter at 50, my heartfelt prayer is that God will surround you with the same love you have freely given to others. May your days ahead be filled with laughter, peace, divine health, and many testimonies of His goodness.

Thank you for being the amazing sister that you are. You are loved, celebrated, and cherished beyond words.

Ọma òdo láyé mi

Ọma òdo mèyìntọlà

Ọma Arúbodó bí ọba

Ó ṣò bì rìkìtì sí ulí àna rẹ̀

Wá ṣùmọ́dọ́n yo yéye o.

Your loving sister,

name: Olatunji Fadeyi
message:
Happy 50th birthday to my incredible sister. I celebrate each of the 50years that have made you a strong, amazing, shining, kind and resilient woman you are today.

You are my constant confidant, my bestie and girlfriend.

You've been a pillar of support for your family and a light to everyone around you.

I wish you happiness, prosperity, a sound mind,   perfect health and long life in Jesus Name.

Cheers!!!.

name: Favour Fadeyi
message:

I really appreciate the amazing person that you are. Your kindness never goes unnoticed, your intelligence inspires me, and your warm spirit brings so much joy to everyone around you. I feel so grateful to have you in my life, not just as family, but as someone I truly admire.

May this new year of your life bring you endless happiness, success in all you do, and peace in your heart. May God continue to bless you, guide you, and uplift you in every way.

Have the most beautiful birthday! You deserve it and so much more

name: Daniel, Deborah, Divine and David Fadeyi
message:
Happy Birthday Aunty Laitan!

We just want to say happy birthday and thank you for always being so kind and caring to us. We really appreciate you and everything you do. We hope you have a lovely day and that this year brings you lots of happiness and good things. You deserve it.

Love from your nieces and nephews,

name: Pst Mrs Abimbola Onyeemeosi
message:
Happy birthday, sis.

You are not just my sister but a mother figure(a position you stepped into immediately we lost our mum about 29 years ago, as an undergraduate). I remembered when you came home for the Easter holiday from OAU and I was down with malaria. You were not ready to leave me in that state, so you got me a rare malaria medication that did wonder in a very short time because you were to leave for school the next morning.

Your boldness, courage and attitude towards life are exceptional; you are unique in so many ways. A beacon of light and hope to anyone who comes your way. A counsellor par excellence, ah! that aspect of you is something else - you can literally use your counsel to align your counselee into the fulfilment of his or her destiny.

A lioness that faces anything without fear because of the confidence you have in Christ. A goal getter, you don't back out easily on your dreams and vision, an attribute I discovered in you as far back as when you were asked to go to Ondo State Polytechnic instead of university.  Your response that Sunday morning(dressed and ready to go for workers' meeting) has a permanent space in my head. You said, 'I  have the richest father, who has the longest leg'. Your JAMB result came, and boom - OAU straight.

You are a mother to many, a big mummy to my boys.

As you celebrate your 50th today, the Lord of heaven will bless you with every beautiful thing your heart desires.  He will launch you to a better and brand new beginning. He will keep you and all that is yours. He will keep your home and if He delays His coming, you will see your children's children. He will make your life so beautiful in Jesus name. The Lord will make you an eternal excellency, the joy of many generations.

Here is to another 50 years of continuous positive impacts on people and all round fulfilment. Congratulations on your golden celebration egbon mi.

name: Pastor Lucky Ewere Onyeemeosi
message:
Blessed birthday celebration to you, my beloved, bold and blessed sister from another mother. Beautiful inside out, a special gift from God to humanity and particularly to Pastor Joshua Olaleye. Kind-hearted, caring, and God-fearing.

A passionate pharmacist with a vision, spirit-filled pastor, loaded and needed, a dynamic counsellor, erudite scholar, indefatigable mother and lots more.

On this occasion of your golden jubilee, I rejoice and celebrate with you. It's my prayer that God will uphold you, strengthen you and multiply His goodness upon you in Jesus name. Big big congratulations

With love from

name: Bright, Barachel & Benjamin Ewere Onyeemeosi
message:
PICP Rivers Province 21

PH Rivers state.

Happy Birthday, Big Mummy ❤️🎉

Thank you for your love, strength, and everything you do. We are truly grateful for you and all the ways you’ve shaped our lives.

Wishing you good health, happiness, and many more beautiful years ahead. We love you always ❤️

name: Temitope and Mary Fadeyi
message:
My sweet sister,

You are more than a sister, you are a blessing to the family and me. Celebrating you today and always. Happy 50th birthday, egbon.

Happy 50th birthday to my beautiful sister-in-love!I am so grateful to have you as my big sister and friend. Wishing you an amazing birthday filled with all the love you give to our family, may your dreams grow bigger and your worries smaller with every passing year. We love you, ma.

name: Opeyemi Fadeyi
message:
Happy 50th birthday to my incredible big sister! You have such a generous heart and a soul that truly shines. I love how you’re always pushing the people around you to grow into their best selves.

​I pray that life continues to favour you in the most beautiful ways and that God satisfies your heart with every good thing. Keep thriving and shining like the diamond that you are. I love you, big Sis❤️💖.

name: Abiola and Ibironke Fadeyi
message:
To my dearest big Aunty,

I pray that you celebrate many, many more beautiful years on earth. You are truly the best thing that has ever happened to me. Whenever I am crying or worried, you are always right there by my side.

Whenever I bring an idea to you, you support me, encourage me, and tell me never to give up. You have never once forsaken me, and I am so grateful for your constant love. I pray that this year brings you deep peace, overflowing joy, and everlasting happiness. Happy Birthday, Big Mummy! We love you so much.

With love,

name: Mr. & Mrs Bamidele and Family
message:
Dearest Pastor 'Laitan,

On this milestone of your 50th birthday, the Bamidele family joins the host of heaven and your loved ones to celebrate the "Golden Legacy of Impact" you have so gracefully built.

To us, much more than a woman of God, you have been a sister and a steadfast family member. Your life has been a living testament to the beauty of holiness, the power of a kind heart, and strength through humility.

Thank you for being an immense blessing to our family. Whether through your fervent prayers, your timely words of wisdom, or your infectious smile, you have left an indelible mark on our hearts. Your devotion to the Lord is not just something you preach; it is something you breathe, and we are better for having walked alongside you.

We pray that the next fifty years are even more radiant than the last. May the Lord expand your borders and renew your strength like the eagle’s.

Happy 50th Birthday, Pastor 'Laitan! We love and celebrate you deeply.

With love and prayers,

name: Oluwakemi Olaleye-Adeyemi
message:
Happy 50th Birthday to my beautiful sister-in-law. Olaitan, my chosen sister, my forever friend.

From friendship to family, our journey has been such a blessing. You are truly one of the most beautiful, intelligent, and graceful women I know. Your strength inspires me, your wisdom guides others, and your heart makes everyone feel loved.

May this new chapter bring you divine peace, overflowing joy, good health, and everything your heart has quietly prayed for. You deserve all the love you so freely give, Olaitan.

name: Elijah Olaleye & Family
message: Happy Birthday to an amazing sister-in-law! Thank you for the love, kindness, and happiness you bring into our family. Wishing you a day as special as you are and a year full of blessings.

name: Gbemisola & Adeoye Omoboya

Happy Birthday to our fabulous wife @50

To our amazing pharmacist sister-in-law, Olaleye Olaitan, happy birthday! She is a God-fearing woman. So gentle and calm.

May your special day be as bright and beautiful as you are. Wishing you a year filled with love, laughter, and a healthy dose of joy. May all your dreams come true, and your life be as fulfilling as the care you bring to others. Cheers to many more years of spreading smiles and healing hearts!

name: Johnson and Olaoluwa Balogun
message: Happy Golden Jubilee, ma! Thank you for being so sweet and accommodating. Thank you for being a blessing to us. We pray that the next 50 years will be more than you can ask or think!

name: Pastor and Pastor Mrs Wale Ogunnowo
message:
Fifty years ago, the world received a rare gift in Josephine Olakiitan Olaleye. For the past seven years, we have been privileged to know her not just as a neighbour, but as a wonderful friend.

Pastor (Mrs.) Olaleye is the kind of person who seems to be in ten places at once; solving problems, counselling friends, and checking on neighbours, all while maintaining her signature calm smile. She is a true "goal-getter," yet she remains incredibly humble and approachable. If there were an award for “Most Likely to Help Everyone and Still Ask if You Need More,” she would win it every year.

She has a special gift for making people feel seen and valued. Whether through her wise counsel or her genuine concern for young people, she has touched countless lives and made everyone around her feel like family.

At 50, you aren't just celebrating years; you are celebrating impact, kindness, and strength. Thank you for your heart of gold and your tireless support.

Happy Golden Jubilee! May the Lord crown this new season with joy, favour, and uncommon grace. May your strength be renewed, your labour richly rewarded, and your future even more glorious than your past.

Amen.

name: Abiola Ugwuoke
message: Laitan and I have been friends for over 30 years. We both attended the same secondary school. Happy birthday to you, my beautiful friend. I want to wish you more grace and blessings as you celebrate this golden year. It’s amazing to see how far God has brought you and where he’s still taking you. Wishing you more glorious years ahead. Love you!

name: Chidera Vera Nwokolo
message:
Where do I even begin? You became a mother to me in every sense that truly matters. From my pre-teen years to the woman I am today, you have held my hand, guided my steps, and loved me selflessly.

You didn’t just care for me, you mothered me. Through every high, low, and moment of growth, your presence has been my comfort and your love my safe place. You are the love of my life, and I never take a single second of your devotion for granted.

At 50, you stand as a true Queen; strong, graceful, and deeply rooted in faith. Your resilience and your God-fearing heart inspire me every single day. Thank you for choosing me, for loving me, and for simply being you.

Happy Golden Jubilee, my Queen. May this new chapter bring you endless joy, peace, and all the blessings your beautiful heart deserves.

I love you forever, my Forever Sweet Sixteen.

name: Caroline AA
message:
Thank you for being a blessing to so many — a nurturing mother, a passionate pastor, an inspiring coach, a compassionate counsellor, and so much more.

On this special day, my heartfelt prayer is that God blesses you abundantly, keeps your family healthy, and guides you to even greater heights.

Happy Birthday, Pharm. Pastor Olakiitan Josephine Olaleye.

name: Pastor Bolaji Ogunwo
message: You are grace personified. I am glad our paths crossed.  Keep growing and glowing in grace. Happy 50th Birthday, Ma!

name: Bro Gbenga Ajayi and Family
message:
Your life is a quiet testimony of grace, strength, and unwavering faith. While many see the Pastor leading from the pulpit, we know that beside him stands a woman of prayer, wisdom, and love. You have carried burdens silently, encouraged hearts gently, and poured yourself into the lives of those around you without seeking recognition.

I will never forget the times you welcomed me with open arms, listened without judgment, and reminded me of God’s promises when I felt weary. Your kindness has touched us in ways words cannot fully capture—through your listening ear, your warm smile, and the way you make everyone feel seen and valued.

You embody the beauty of servant leadership, not by title, but by the way you live each day with humility and compassion. You are like a lighthouse, steady and bright, guiding us toward Christ even in the darkest nights.

We honour you not only as our Pastor’s wife but as a mother, sister, and friend in Christ. Thank you for the sacrifices you’ve made, the prayers you’ve prayed, and the love you’ve shared so freely. You are a blessing to this church family, and we are deeply grateful for the light you shine among us.

May the Lord continue to strengthen you, surround you with joy, and reward you abundantly for the seeds of love and faith you have sown in our lives. Happy 50th birthday!

name: The Niyi-Moses’
message:
Happy Golden 50th Pastor Mrs, Pharm O.

You are indeed a gift to mankind. You have touched so many lives with grace, ours included. You are selfless, knowledgeable, kind and a lover of God.

Thank you for all you do for us. We are grateful to God for the opportunity to celebrate you today.

Here is to good health, accomplished dreams and more beautiful impacts ahead.

Cheers!

name: Pst. Goziem & Pst. Mrs. Ngozi Ufodike
message:
We met her at Strongtower in 2010, when they arrived as our new PIC Area. I do not use these words lightly, but in their fullest meaning, to describe my dear Mummy Olaleye:

Amiable, respectable, respectful, focused, smart, goal-getter, ethical, professional, dependable, wise, a counsellor, truly motherly, and Christ-like.

If those words were brushes and colours on the canvas of time, then the portrait of Mummy Olaleye would undoubtedly be a masterpiece.

name: Pastors’ Seed Family, LP44
message:
With hearts full of gratitude to God, the Pastors’ Seed Family LP44 joyfully celebrates a truly exceptional woman as she marks her golden jubilee.

Today, we honour a mother, mentor, and shining example of grace whose life reflects quiet strength, wisdom, and unwavering devotion to God’s work.

Your life speaks of humility, compassion, patience, and deep faith. You have shown us what it means to serve God wholeheartedly while nurturing relationships with love and wisdom.

At 50, we celebrate the beauty of God’s faithfulness in your life. We thank God for the impact you have made and continue to make in the body of Christ. Your journey is an inspiration, and your example is a blueprint of godly womanhood.

Our prayer is that this new chapter will usher in greater joy, divine strength, peace, and fulfilment. May the Lord crown your years with glory, enlarge your coast, and cause you to experience deeper dimensions of His grace and favour.

Happy 50th Birthday, Ma.

Thank you for being a blessing to our generation.

With love and honour,

name: Peace Osemwegie
message:
Aunt Olaitan, you are truly a vessel God has used to shape lives.

I met you at 17 in Minna, and through Teenagers Outreach Ministry, you guided us with truth, wisdom, and courage, teaching what many avoided and planting seeds that still speak today. Living with you for those years showed me your love, strength, and unwavering support. You became like family.

At 50, I celebrate not just your years, but your impact, the lives you’ve touched, and the love you’ve given so freely. Thank you for being you.

Happy 50th Birthday, Ma. May this new chapter be even more beautiful and rewarding.

name: Grace Sesi
message:
Wahoo!! Your 50th birthday isn't just a celebration of age; it's a tribute to the profound impact you've had on mine. When I was lost, you guided me back to solid ground. When I needed support, you were there – no questions asked. Your motherhood saved my life, and your continued presence in my journey means everything.

I remember 10 years ago when Pregnancy almost claimed my life, you stood out as a Guardian Angel that you are, to ensure that I got back the life of Christ in me. You spent and influenced others to spend just to save my life. Your husband prayed and influenced others to join him. Your late mother-in-law (Grandma Oworo) played her part due to your Influence.

My God-sent angel, as I proudly call you. Words fail me.

You've mastered the art of caring without expecting anything in return. Your wisdom, kindness, and generosity inspire me daily. I see the way you lead with empathy, tackle challenges with Grace, and uplift everyone around you. It's a rare gift, and I'm grateful to be among the many lives you've touched. Your ability to understand and meet needs before they're even spoken is a superpower. You've shown me what it means to truly care for others, to invest in people, and to make a difference without seeking recognition. Your legacy is one of kindness, impact, and love.

Here's to many more years of your light shining bright, guiding others, and touching hearts. Thank you for being my rock, my angel, my mentor, and my inspiration. I'm honoured to celebrate you on this milestone birthday, Mama eee.

name: Layade Family “The Incredibles”
message:
Thank you for being a calm, patient and caring friend. A professional in truth and in deed. A pastor who cares spiritually, physically and professionally. Enjoy today and the future in Christ. God bless.

With love from

name: Henry Obasanya
message: What a day to celebrate a rare gem, a gift from God to us. When my brother told me he found the lady, within me I thought she must be an angel, and when I met you, you are beyond an angel. Thank you for being such a great addition and a blessing to us all. I pray that this landmark birthday will usher in more glorious and productive years, your gifts will multiply as you continue to impact generations positively.   Even in old age, you will win more souls. In this world and His kingdom, you will enjoy your rewards in Jesus name. Happy birthday, my darling.

name: Tola Julius and Family
message:
You are indeed a mentor, someone I can look up to and say boldly, " I want to be like you". You inspire me with your lifestyle, attitude, behaviour and the way you relate with young and old. Thank God for bringing you my way. Thank you, mummy, for your selfless service to the people of God and to God Almighty. May God keep you to celebrate many more years of his faithfulness in Jesus Name and God bless your home and family.

With love from

name: Temidayo Oderinde
message:
Today, I celebrate a truly special woman, my aunt, Pastor Laitan Olaleye. You have been a strong pillar in my life and a constant source of support through my journey. In moments when I needed direction, encouragement, or someone to simply believe in me, you were always there. Your love, care, and kindness have shaped me in more ways than I can fully express.

What makes you exceptional is your genuine heart of love. You are deeply caring, loving, and always accommodating, making everyone around you feel valued and at home. Thank you for your prayers, your sacrifices, and the role you have played in my growth. I do not take any of it for granted.

As you celebrate a Golden Jubilee, I pray that God continues to bless you, strengthen you, and reward you richly. Happy birthday, ma. You are truly loved and appreciated.

name: Pst Toroti Akin-Taylor
message:
When I think of vision, passion and compassion, Pastor Laitan is one of the first people that cross my mind.

A woman who is graced for and dedicated to her assignment. Full of wisdom yet meek and selfless, with a hunger and determination to see a new generation of young leaders and nation builders emerge. Working and serving with purity of heart and clarity of purpose.

I truly thank God for choosing this great woman of God, I thank God for helping her for 50 great years and I thank God for the glory of the next 50! As your days so shall your strength be! New mountains and territories! Greater impact and victories! Every one of God’s promises made to you shall begin to manifest speedily.

Isaiah 60 verse 10 (60-10 =50). May Foreigners build up your walls and may their kings serve you. May you enjoy an unexplainable level of favour, grace and mercy! Amen.

Happy 50th, Pastor Ma!

name: Oluwatomisin Olayinka
message:
To a Woman of Substance and Intellect,

Mummy, you are truly unique, special, and wonderfully made.

I admire your intelligence and integrity so much; these are the qualities that first drew me to you. If I miss any other Sunday, I never miss the third Sunday when you teach. You don’t just "preach", you speak on the facts of life with such wisdom and clarity. The way you analyse matters and choose your words is top-notch and truly needs to be studied.

I especially love your teaching that we must put in the effort so that God has something to crown. I bless the day I first stepped into the church; I am so glad I found this community with you at the heart of it.

I celebrate God’s mercy in your life, especially for protecting you since childhood, for the mission you are fulfilling today. I am constantly in awe of your strength. Even when life gets busy, and everyone runs to you for help, you carry that grace so effortlessly.

Thank you for giving me a safe space to be vulnerable. Thank you for your listening ear and for never exploiting my trust when I need to rant. You are a rare gift.

I could go on forever!

Happy 50th Milestone, Mummy!

name: Herald Dare, Kokopelli Africa Founder
message:
Some people don’t just pass through your life; they will stay and make their mark. That’s what Mummy Olaleye (as we fondly call her) has been to me. And I feel deep gratitude whenever I think of her.

I first met her in 2014 when I joined Strong Tower, and from the beginning, there was something about her. Gracious, sound and quietly firm. Not the kind of presence that overwhelms you, but the kind that steadies you. You just knew this was someone who took people seriously. The kind of aura that makes you behave yourself without anybody talking, but it took me a little while to warm up to her.

Then, over time, I began to experience her care, not the showy type but very intentional. She paid attention, and before I even realised it, she was investing in me in ways that have stuck.

Small conversations started to carry weight. Little corrections started to make sense. You’d think it was just normal guidance, until you look back and realise, this woman has been shaping you.

Then it became more personal. I remember how she began to get involved in areas people usually don’t bother with, especially money. Not just advice like “save” or “be wise,” but real involvement. Sitting me down, asking questions, guiding decisions, even keeping money for me so I wouldn’t touch it. At the time, it felt like extra supervision, but now I see it for what it was, care with foresight. I remember one day, she even gave me a book, The Richest Man in Babylon and simply told me to read it. That meant a whole lot. As if that’s not enough, she literally made me join a business masterclass at that time that opened my eyes to a lot as an entrepreneur. I cannot exhaust the list of her impact.

And it was not just me. I saw how she is with others too. Young adults and even teenagers in church. The way she poured into them, guided them, corrected them. She was not just leading, but raising people.

Somewhere along the line, she became more than a pastor to me. She became a mother, and even after I left the church, she never stepped back. She still reached out, still prays with me, still shows care. I will never forget that during my wedding, she came all the way from Lagos to Abuja despite a tight schedule. You can’t buy this in the market. Money cannot buy this; she is priceless. That’s who she is. She always shows up.

At 50, Ma, your life is a story of impact. Not noise, not performance, but real lives changed, real seeds planted, real growth that continues long after the moment has passed. I am one of those lives, and I carry that with gratitude and with pride.

Thank you for seeing me, for guiding me, for being consistent. Thank you for loving me in a way that has also shaped me.

I pray that everything you have poured into others comes back to you in ways that bring you joy, peace, and fulfilment.

Happy 50th Birthday, Ma.

You are deeply loved and truly appreciated.

name: Pharm Charles Oyeniyi
message: Pharm Laitan and her husband have been very dear friends to me. She will go the extra mile just to see how she can be of help to you anytime you reach out to her. I wish her the best things in life and she will fulfil her purpose in Christ Jesus. Welcome to the Fifth floor, my dear sister.

name: Pastor Wole & Anamiyie Adewuyi
message:
Happy 50th Birthday, Pastor Pharm Mrs Olakiitan Josephine Olaleye.

You are a true and intentional mother whose life has blessed so many. Your prayers, love, and sacrifices have lifted lives and shaped destinies.

On this special day, we pray that God renews your strength, fills your heart with joy, and rewards you abundantly for all you do. May your oil never run dry.

You are deeply loved and greatly appreciated.

Happy Golden Jubilee, ma.

name: Victoria Inok
message:
You are a breath of fresh air in this world, Mummy. Growing up under your care was God’s gift to me. I watched you build and learned how to build, watched you love and learned how to love, watched you serve God and learned how to serve Him.

You are a precious gem, Ma. I pray that the best of your years are ahead of you in Jesus name.

name: Honourable A/P Mojibola Anthonia Oyeneye
message:
A Tribute to a Partner in Progress

Our journey began in 2003 at Maranatha Chapel. We were both young ministers in the teens church then. But even in those early days, a foundation of friendship and sisterhood was laid, one built on mutual respect and a shared vision for the future.

If I were to describe you in a few words, it would be as my "partner in progress." Your life is a testament to integrity, trustworthiness, and an unwavering dedication to service. I still vividly remember watching you work at HealthPlus pharmacy years ago. Even in the height of your pregnancy and through bad weather, your work ethic never wavered. It was that very diligence that inspired me to encourage you to start your own journey, leading to the birth of the first Springcare Pharmacy.

Your consistency is remarkable. In a business climate that presents constant challenges, you have remained committed to your staff and your mission. The fact that team members stay with you for seven years or more speaks volumes about the kind of leader and role model you are. You are sincere, you are a seeker of truth, and you are always striving to do more.

As you reach this incredible milestone, I want you to know how deeply proud I am of the woman you have become and everything you have accomplished. My prayer for you as you enter this new season is that every dream and desire in your heart finds its fulfilment. May you be connected with the right people who will help you achieve your goals seamlessly.

Happy 50th Birthday to a truly exceptional woman.

With love and prayers,

name: Calista Oluchu Emma-Anya
message:
An Amazing God's General,

Your life has been more than impactful!

As a life coach in God's vineyard, you have been raising a generation of impactful people, especially youths, who are holding their heads high.  Your humane nature is one quality that my family, particularly my children, adore.

This is a golden celebration and I pray that your paths will continually be lined with GOLD. Good health will not elude you. Congratulations, Ma.

name: Mrs Bukola Onigbanjo & Family
message:
A Golden Tribute to our Mummy - Pastor Mrs Olakiitan Josephine Olaleye at 50

Today, with hearts full of gratitude and joy, my family and I celebrate an extraordinary woman, Pastor Mrs Olakiitan Josephine Olaleye (fondly called O.J.O, @iamlaitanolaleye), on the beautiful occasion of her 50th birthday.

Fifty years of grace, strength, resilience, unwavering faith. impact, love, and purpose. Your life has been a shining light to everyone privileged to know you.

As a mother, you have been nurturing, wise, and deeply devoted—raising not just children, but pillars for tomorrow. As a sister and friend, you have been dependable, compassionate, and loving. As a woman of purpose, your passion for uplifting others and serving your community continues to inspire generations. (Lagos Coordinator; I Lead, Anchor RSTA Family Service, CEO Springcare Pharmacy, amongst others ).

We, your family, celebrate not just your age, but your journey—every sacrifice made, every prayer whispered, every life touched. You have given so much of yourself, and today we honour you for the love you so freely share. As you step into this golden milestone, we pray that you experience Christ even more deeply, and that your life continues to radiate His light and glory.

Thank you for being genuine all the way—consistent, selfless, and true.

Happy 50th Birthday ma, Pastor Mrs Olakiitan.

We love you deeply—today and always.

( In Bukola Onigbanjo's voice, I say I love you gan and respect your personality)

1John 4:16

— With all our love, Your Family

name: John Akinola-Adetoro
message:
Hello Mommy, happy, happy birthday to you on this beautiful and special Golden Jubilee.

I want you to know how much I love and appreciate you. I’m so grateful for the years and for every moment you’ve poured into my life. I still remember when you would look at me and say, “John, I see greatness in you.” Those words have stayed with me; they’ve become defining at strategic moments in my life. Even now, I remember hearing your voice speaking life, speaking hope, through different platforms and it keeps me inspired.

I always say you have the energy of 5 youths put together. You move with such vibrant energy that it's difficult to imagine a challenge you can't overcome. There’s nothing I’ve ever brought to you as an idea or plan that you didn’t find ways to support. Even when things didn’t turn out the way I expected, you remained constantly supportive.

I am also inspired by how reflective you are, how you see things from different angles, and how you’re always willing to evaluate yourself. That’s something I’ve learned from you, and I carry it with me.  I’m truly grateful for the gift of you, Ma. I love you very much.

name: Chidinma Akinola-Adetoro
message:
Happy birthday, Ma. Thank you for being an example of excellent values. Thank you for living an intentional life. Thank you for being a person of integrity and a very authentic person.

And I want to say thank you for believing in my husband and me. I mean, I hear you say things like, I see you guys and what you do going all over the world. And that means so much, so much to me, so much to us. You are someone I know who really believes in us, and not just in words—even your resources have been directed towards your faith in us, your confidence in who we are becoming.

You have backed us with your name. We say thank you. Thank you. You have put your integrity forward for our sake, honestly. Words cannot really quantify or express how grateful we are and how much we appreciate your sacrifice. You have brought us into doors that most likely wouldn’t have been easy, definitely wouldn’t have been easy for us.

You are so proud of us. You announce us everywhere you take us to. Even in our flaws, you act like you don’t see them, as though we are flawless. That’s really how unconditional your love is towards us. And you correct us with firmness and love. Like, whenever we hear your correction, we do not doubt your love for us.

Thank you. I’m grateful. My husband is grateful. Our family is grateful.

name: Kenneth Ilenre
message:
Happy Golden Jubilee Birthday, dear Pastor (Mrs.) Olakiitan Olaleye.

I celebrate the gift of your incredible life of purpose, compassion and faith. Your unwavering commitment to Godly values has been a guiding light to many. Your life highlights your positive impact on many lives and your dedication to meeting both spiritual and practical needs.

As you mark this special milestone, may you be surrounded by the same joy, peace, and kindness you have so freely given. May your legacy continue to inspire, and may your years ahead be more fruitful and fulfilling in Jesus' Name. Congratulations, Ma.

name: Ricketts Magdalene Franklyn
message:
Happy 50th Birthday, Mrs O

It’s a privilege to celebrate 50 years of impact, discipline, and excellence with you. Your leadership and kindness have shaped many of us — we’re grateful. Wishing you continued health, strength, and fulfilment in the years ahead. God bless.

name: Adeniyi oluwawande
message:
Fifty years of grace, strength, and beautiful memories—your journey inspires everyone around you.

You’ve turned moments into milestones and dreams into reality with courage and love.

Here’s to more laughter, good health, and amazing years ahead—happy golden birthday! Mrs O🎉

name: Dr. Victor Okolie (Pharm. D)
message:
Happy 50th Birthday to you, Mrs O.

I celebrate not just your years, but the wisdom and excellence you possess and have come to pour into me.

Your guidance has helped shape my path and sharpen my skills in this profession. Thank you. Congratulations on your Golden Jubilee, and I wish you many more beautiful, fulfilling years ahead.

name: Mariam Ayomide Falade
message:
Ma, today I just want to take a moment to honour and appreciate you for who you are to me and to so many others.

You are not just a mother, a boss, or a pastor — you are someone I deeply respect and genuinely admire. As a mother, your strength, patience, and love are truly inspiring. The way you care, give, and stand strong for your family speaks volumes about your character.

As my boss, you have been more than a leader to me. You have been a mentor, a guide, and a source of encouragement. Working under you has taught me so much — not just professionally, but personally.

Your excellence as a pharmacist, your discipline, and the way you handle responsibilities with grace continue to challenge me to be better every day.

As my pastor during my Bible College IT, you have impacted my life spiritually in ways I cannot fully express.

Your teachings, prayers, and words of encouragement have strengthened my faith and given me direction. You lead with humility, sincerity, and a genuine love for God and His people.

Ma, one thing that stands out about you is your consistency. Whether at home, at work, or in church, you remain the same — kind, strong, wise, and full of grace. I feel truly blessed and privileged to be under your leadership and guidance. Thank you for your patience, your support, and the many ways you have invested in my life.

I celebrate you today and always. You are deeply appreciated, and your impact will never be forgotten.
